title: Relaxing drug laws: a good idea?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What is the strongest argument for relaxing drug laws, and what is the strongest argument against it?
Would treating drug use more as a health issue than a criminal issue improve society?
Should different drugs be regulated differently instead of being treated under one policy?
How could a country reduce harm without appearing to encourage drug use?
What evidence would you want to see before supporting a major change in drug policy?
